LanguageData.ARIO_WorldModeVanillaDesc: A normal rimworld. Outlander towns, mechanoids, hives and modern tech all remain. House, culture and dynasty systems still work.
LanguageData.ARIO_WorldModeThrones: A Rim of Ice and Fire
LanguageData.ARIO_WorldModeThronesDesc: The true map of Westeros, from the Lands of Always Winter to Dorne. You set the realm's rules on the next page.
LanguageData.ARIO_WorldModeHint: Click to choose · double-click to begin
LanguageData.ARIO_WorldModeNextThrones: Next: set the realm's rules, then Westeros
LanguageData.ARIO_WesterosWorldIntro: An authored Westeros, from the frozen far north to Dorne. Choose the lesser-House count, climate and realm rules; borders and House seats stay fixed.
LanguageData.ARIO_WesterosAtlasUnavailable: The Westeros map data is missing or damaged. Generation has been cancelled; check the mod installation.
LanguageData.ARIO_WesterosWorldSizeDesc: Controls how much of the globe RimWorld generates, not its tile density. Westeros uses the same authored outline, fitted to the available northern region. More coverage takes longer to generate.
LanguageData.ARIO_WesterosMorePeriods: This is the only available period. More periods will be added soon.
LanguageData.ARIO_WesterosChoosePeriod: Select a period before generating Westeros.
LanguageData.ARIO_WesterosForeignFactions: Non-Westerosi factions will also be generated.
LanguageData.ARIO_WesterosFactionPlacement: Every listed regional faction and its lesser-House vassals are confined to the named region.
LanguageData.ARIO_WesterosCanonicalRegionsDesc: Required for the authored Westeros map. Every regional faction, lesser House, seat and holdfast is placed inside its own named territory.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupModeSubtitle: Choose how this world should be played.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupModeVanillaDesc: The rim stays as it is. Outlander towns, mechanoids, insect hives and modern technology all remain. The House, culture and dynasty systems are still available to you, but nothing about the world is rewritten.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupModeThrones: A Rim of Ice and Fire
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupModeThronesDesc: Convert this world into the Seven Kingdoms. You choose exactly which conversion rules apply on the next page, then found your House.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupLauncherHidden: Setup Medallion hidden. You can continue or reopen the setup from the medallion in the Dynasty tab.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRulesSubtitle: Nothing is changed unless you tick it. What you tick is enforced for the whole game.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleSettlementsDesc: Removes unoccupied settlements outside the Westerosi Houses and stops new foreign settlements from appearing. Your colony, holdings, the Night's Watch, and factions protected by the preservation rules are exempt. Settlements with loaded maps are not removed.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleMechanoidsDesc: Retires the mechanoid faction, blocks every mechanoid incident and cluster, and clears machines already standing on your maps, including a sealed ancient danger.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleHiveDesc: Retires the insect faction, blocks infestations, and burns out any hive already present.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleTechDesc: Locks industrial research and later, and keeps modern gear out of traders, rewards and arriving pawns.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleIdeosDesc: Remove unused ideoligions that no House or living person follows.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleFactionsDesc: Remove non-Westerosi factions except those selected below.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleRegionalIdeosDesc: Every faction in the world follows a Westerosi faith. Each House takes its own culture's creed and lesser Houses share their liege's instead of inventing a private copy. Any other faction left in play is matched to the nearest fit: tribal peoples keep the old gods, settled realms follow the Seven. Your own colony's faith is never changed.
LanguageData.ARIO_PeriodSandboxDesc: Start with no scripted storyline and no fixed historical progression. The Houses, their seats and their rivalries are all in place, but nothing is scheduled to happen on rails — the realm develops from what you and the storyteller do. This is the only period available while the authored storylines are unfinished.
LanguageData.ARIO_WesterosFaithsFailed: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] Westerosi-only faiths could not install; the original regional-faith rule is unchanged: {0}
LanguageData.ARIO_RealmSetupLayoutFailed: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] Realm setup keeps its original layout: {0}
LanguageData.ARIO_RealmModeLayoutFailed: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] The world chooser keeps its original layout: {0}
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleExtraFactionsDesc: Adds 1–10 lesser Houses to each supported region. Each begins sworn as a vassal to its regional faction, uses an authored House name and receives one fixed seat in its home territory.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupSliderPlayerDistance: Minimum House distance from your colony: {0} tiles
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupSliderFactionDistance: Minimum distance between House seats: {0} tiles
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupSliderHouseSettlementDistance: Maximum holdfast distance from its House seat: {0} tiles
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupScaleWarning: This will found {0} new lesser Houses as regional vassals, holding about {1} new holdfasts. Every holdfast becomes land the realm tracks, so a wide setting means a busier map and a larger save.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleRelocate: Relocate regional factions to their biomes
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRuleRelocateDesc: Moves each culture to ground that suits it. Your distance settings keep House seats away from your colony and one another, while the culture suited to your landing biome is still placed nearest.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRulesConfirmTitle: Are you sure you wish to continue?
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupRulesConfirmBody: Once these settings are applied, you cannot return to this setup page.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupHouseSubtitle: Name your House and choose its sigil.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupHouseHint: Your region suggests a sigil and faith; you may change both.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupFaithKeepDesc: Nothing changes. Your colonists keep the ideoligion they already believe in.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupDebugReopen: Reopen the new colony setup from the first page.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupDebugRerun: Run the saved world conversion again.
LanguageData.ARIO_SetupDebugNoRules: This colony has no saved conversion rules. Reopen the setup and choose a game of thrones first.
